content: Let me save a lesson about this stuck state, then try waiting longer — maybe the game resolves the overlap over time (e.g., the notice board is temporary).

args.lesson: When spawned overlapping a blocking object (notice board at your own tile), raw movement and walk_to both fail with "in the way: <object> at <your tile>"; try waiting for time to pass or re-observing rather than retrying the same direction.
